IC1: 1. Hypoxemia defined by a ratio of the partial pressure of arterial oxygen to the fraction of inspired oxygen (PaO2:FiO2) ≤ 300 while the patient is breathing oxygen through NHF for at least 15 minutes;
IC3: 3. Partial pressure of arterial carbon dioxide (PaCO2) ≤ 45 mmHg;
IC4: 4. [NOT] Absence of clinical history of underlying chronic respiratory failure.
